title: Resources
text:
This (somewhat Macalester-specific) student resources document and this Quarto website guide, both created by Professor Brianna Heggeseth, first got me interested in creating a website.
I had never used git or Github prior to this project. The UC Santa Barbara Bren School of Environmental Science and Management’s software installation guide was a great introduction to how to configure both.
Now, working with Quarto, I’m constantly referencing Sam Shanny-Csik’s materials - her resources are so approachable, thorough, and easy to understand:

Creating your personal website using Quarto
Creating your own personal branding guide (under the ‘Pre-class prep’ section)
Customizing Quarto websites slideshow

title: Sophia Spisak
text:
Hi! I’m Sophia Spisak. I’m a senior at Macalester College in St. Paul, MN, majoring in Geography with minors in Geospatial Science and Data Science.
Please see the Projects tab for samples of my academic work; more will be added as time allows. My Resources page includes materials that have been helpful in learning how to build this website.
Thank you for visiting my website.

title: Projects
text:
Remote Sensing
For my Introduction to Remote Sensing class, I independently researched how early-winter snow cover has changed in Minnesota across the past two decades. I used Python and RStudio to process 700 MODIS satellite images. Please see this presentation for an overview of the process and results.


Additional projects will be added soon.
